title: Handle reverted completed work and reconcile unnamed finished tasks
description: Existing landed Closes reconciliation is safer than the older COMBATRIG manual closer. Extend with verified revert awareness and a low-cost reviewed open-task/code audit. Backlog terminal-state semantics currently lack reopen; define a spec-backed reopen or linked follow-up transition before implementation. A revert may not undo all outcomes; do not reopen solely from an untrusted commit message.
acceptanceCriteria: Only verified relevant landed revert evidence can trigger the reviewed follow-up/reopen policy
An audit proposes evidence-linked closure or follow-up; it cannot mass-close guessed finished tasks
Exact landing/check evidence and idempotence are retained for original task and reversal lineage
